offering_description.value: Designs and sells smart electricity, gas and water meters, communication networks and utility software that utilities use to measure, manage and analyze energy and water use. Sells mainly to utilities and municipalities, delivering hardware, networks and cloud software along with deployment and managed services.

primary_products.value: smart electricity, gas and water meters; communication networks and modules; meter data management software

primary_services.value: managed network and software services; deployment and installation; data analytics; consulting

customer_segment.value: B2B: electric, gas and water utilities, energy retailers; B2G: municipal and government-owned utilities, city agencies

end_markets.value: electric utilities; gas utilities; water utilities; smart cities; distributed energy resources

revenue_model.value: product sales: meters, communication modules and network hardware sold to utilities; subscription: software and cloud-based analytics and network services; service fees: installation, managed services and support contracts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and makes meters and network hardware, sold to utilities; software / platform: meter data management and analytics software sold to utilities; service provider: deployment, managed network operations and support for utilities
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Utilities across North America, Europe, Asia Pacific, Latin America and other regions worldwide

specialization.value: related lines: smart meters, communication networks and utility software, all sold to utilities

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Itron sales teams selling directly to utility accounts; partners / resellers: system integrators and channel partners serving utilities

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: utility regulators and rules on metering accuracy, radio frequency emissions and data privacy
